oracle: Weighted edge cover reduces to sum_v cheapest_incident(v) minus maximum-weight partial bipartite matching with gain(v,w)=max(0,cheapest(v)+cheapest(w)-cost(v,w)). Square padded Hungarian assignment computes maximum gain; an independent subset-assignment DP self-checks every case with a color size<=10. Neither uses coordinate sorting/block decomposition/one-overlap recurrence, nor the author coverage-mask/all-edge-subset/two-dimensional-prefix oracles.
allocationFailureScope: Every allocation in the public const-reference API and the original value-vector adapter is failed in turn; check input constness and fresh valid call after each exception. Adapter copies account for two extra allocations.
